notes.title: We celebrate Russian translation with 40% off!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25723393/a761c670860231fbf57c99cfa65462f2496cba51.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone! Today we are glad to announce that we have updated Slap Village: Reality Slap! with Russian translation and other gameplay improvements. 

We are very happy with this update so we want to share it with all of you with 40% off!

The new update includes:

•	Additional language: thanks to the fantastic work of Tolma4Team, we can offer Slap Village now also in Russian. Amazing job of this Russian’s guys! 
•	Optimization improvements.
•	Gameplay improvements.

Don’t miss the chance to join Lurdita’s adventure in this funny and crazy Point and Click game!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25723393/2b837d8ed52396424d3e320d13cec70c392c8143.jpg[/img]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/480900

The sale period ends at 19 October

notes.title: Slap Village now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
We are proud to announce that today, 21 of July, the 2D adventure game Slap Village is available on Steam for both PC and Mac at a price of 14.99 $ and a release discount of 10% during the first week.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25723393/ad248079ee798e7e041b9f5b444094daf1bb3081.jpg[/img]

Slap Village is a point and click adventure game inspired by the classics of this genre merging the topics of the Wild West with nowadays concepts. The story, which is starred by the young town girl Lurditas, is set in an anachronistic universe with scenarios and characters typically from that historical period, yet blended with technologies and characteristics of the modern life. 

Hope you enjoy it! ːsteamhappyː
